A name that fits in two lines is one run of text, with the ending right after the last word. A longer name clamps only its base, and the ending stands beside the base's last line. The card measures this before paint, and again when the name or its width changes. Third review (71f5a7a): the reviewer's blocking finding is real. On 1d693cb the measurement was compared with the width the ResizeObserver last saw. That observer is off while Rename is open and while the name has no ending. So if the card was resized or rotated in those moments and the name then changed, every measurement looked stale and was redone before paint, until React threw "Maximum update depth exceeded" and the dashboard went blank. Now each measurement also records the width it was taken at, so the card measures once. The hover title and the stored name still hold the full text, and the two-column lg grid from 8a17031 is unchanged. | There is still no real-browser layout check at 1024 px. tests/pdf/104 uses a crude fake line layout (every `cpl` characters is one line), not real text metrics. A browser that reports scrollHeight one pixel over clientHeight for a name that fits would show the split layout, which is still correct but has a small gap. The name is not measured again when only the web fonts finish loading at the same width.
